== Summary ==
Slip “•General Poe Dameron” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF file created 6 October 2023), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 200, 581, 923)). Version [[General Poe Dameron]] (Original). Not a recreation.
